description: Hypothesis: loading all eight uchar4 payload vectors of each affine expert K32 tile before decoding/storing them improves prefill over the 2171.1 tok/s base. This changes only expert load/decode scheduling; affine-8 group-64 cache v2, BF16 scale/bias, FP16 operands/KV, FP32 accumulation/state, dynamic live-row tensor extents, fused gate/up, single-stage synchronization, 2048-token chunks, staged8 DeltaNet, DFlash2 and 32768-token context are unchanged. The evaluator is pinned to current main; its definition and all 17 script hashes are identical to the base. Run all seven Full-profile tests. Prior diagnostic throughput gains were 7.18% at 10K and 6.26% at 30K versus a later original-shader control; these are development evidence, not the expected official score.
